course_name_original: Trabajo fin de grado en Ingeniería Mecánica (471)
course_name_en: Final Degree Project in Mechanical Engineering
prerequisites: All those that provide technical knowledge and sectoral competencies.

learning_outcomes.text: Will be able to draft and develop projects in the field of industrial engineering.
Will be able to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning, and communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Will be able to handle mandatory specifications, regulations, and standards.
Will be able to analyze and assess the social and environmental impact of technical solutions.
Will know, understand, and be able to apply the necessary legislation in the practice of the Industrial Technical Engineer profession.

syllabus_topics: Adapted to the specific objectives of the Final Degree Project
assessment_rules: Both the documentation and the presentation must have a minimum quality. During the presentation, any questions raised by the Tribunal members will be clarified. To proceed with the defense of the Final Degree Project, it is an essential requirement to have passed all subjects comprising the degree.
